title: Law of iterated logarithm for inner functions
summary: In a recent work [\emph{Adv. Math.} 401 (2022), Paper No. 108318], a central limit theorem was established for the linear combinations of the iterates of a non-rotational inner function fixing the origin. In this paper, we prove the law of iterated logarithm (LIL) in the same setup, with a very mild condition on the coefficients. We also identify the full set of subsequential limit points at the LIL scale.
